integrity.claims_supported_by: proof, exact rational Bernstein certificates, 256-subset enumeration, derivative sign analysis
open_issues: Independent scientific audit and exhaustive historical priority search not performed.

scientific_limitations: The sharp \(m=7\) boundary is proved only in the two-block reduced model; it is not a global minimum over all rooted trees. The positive-edge eight-tip example has a multifurcating seven-tip clade. Only independent homogeneous survival and rooted phylogenetic diversity are treated; no empirical extinction forecasts are made.
title: Two variance peaks in future phylogenetic diversity: a sharp two-block clade threshold
